ca_lost_horse_area.name: Lost Horse Area
ca_lost_horse_area.note: Joshua Tree season early/mid Oct to late Apr; best late Oct-early Dec and Mar-Apr; no Lost Horse-specific schedule found.

id_city_of_rocks.name: City of Rocks
id_city_of_rocks.note: Sources name May-June and Sep-Oct; summer hot, winter snow; edges vary (some say May-Oct, one Sep-Nov).

co_ouray_vicinity_rock.name: Ouray
co_ouray_vicinity_rock.note: Only the ice park season (mid-Dec to ~Apr 1) found; no rock-climbing months.

ca_central_gorge.name: Central Gorge
ca_central_gorge.note: Sources give season words only (fall/winter/spring; spring and fall; one says Mar-Oct) with no agreed months.

ca_upper_gorge.name: Upper Gorge
ca_upper_gorge.note: Sources give season words only (fall/winter/spring; spring and fall; one says Mar-Oct) with no agreed months.

ca_inner_gorge.name: Inner Gorge
ca_inner_gorge.note: Sources give season words only (fall/winter/spring; spring and fall; one says Mar-Oct) with no agreed months.

ca_mount_woodson.name: Mount Woodson
ca_mount_woodson.note: Only hiking sources (fall-spring, Oct-May); no climbing season found.

ut_logan_canyon.name: Logan Canyon
ut_logan_canyon.note: Spring to fall by words only; winter climbing near impossible; no months.

on_niagara_glen.name: Niagara Glen
on_niagara_glen.note: Spring and fall best by words only; no months named.

tx_reimers_ranch.name: Reimers Ranch
tx_reimers_ranch.note: Described as year-round; no season window named.

id_black_cliffs.name: Black Cliffs
id_black_cliffs.note: Mountain Project: spring and fall best (summer very hot); guide names Mar-May and Sep-Nov; winter possible on sunny days.

ut_boulders_little_cottonwood.name: Boulders - Little Cottonwood
ut_boulders_little_cottonwood.note: Fall and spring best (Oct-Nov sweet spot); Mad Boulder says spring-fall; no agreed month list.

ab_moose_mountain.name: Moose Mountain
ab_moose_mountain.note: Only hiking-access info (road closed to mid-May); no climbing season found.

nh_cathedral_ledge.name: Cathedral Ledge
nh_cathedral_ledge.note: Spring/late spring through fall, May start, autumn favoured; words only, seepage in spring.

co_central.name: Central
co_central.note: Spring and fall by words only; peak-season claims conflict (Feb-May vs Jan-Feb).

co_eldorado_canyon_state_park.name: Eldorado Canyon State Park
co_eldorado_canyon_state_park.note: Spring through fall by words only; park open year-round.

nv_second_pullout_calico_ii.name: Second Pullout (Calico II)
nv_second_pullout_calico_ii.note: Red Rocks: Oct to early Apr best, prime Nov-Mar; shoulder months need shade; not Calico-specific.

az_oak_flat.name: Oak Flat
az_oak_flat.note: Winter by words only; no months named.

ca_stoney_point.name: Stoney Point
ca_stoney_point.note: One source says Aug-Nov; forums say rain is the limit; no agreement.

id_massacre_rocks.name: Massacre Rocks
id_massacre_rocks.note: Mountain Project: late fall and early spring best, winter days climbable, summer too hot; guide names Mar-May and Sep-Nov. BLM portion closed to climbing.
